outline: A brief introduction of general chemistry and chemical reactions, covering atomic structure and bonding, quantitative chemistry, gas, thermodynamics, kinetics, etc. In addition to the basic principles of chemistry, this course will focus on letting students understand the relationship between chemistry and daily life.
